description: This file defines extension methods for ISiloBuilder and IServiceCollection to add and configure a custom storage-based log consistency provider within the Orleans hosting framework. It includes methods for adding the provider as default, configuring options, and registering necessary services.

classes.name: CustomStorageSiloBuilderExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods to configure custom storage log consistency providers for Orleans silos.

methods.name: AddCustomStorageBasedLogConsistencyProviderAsDefault
methods.description: Adds a custom storage log consistency provider as the default implementation for the silo builder.

methods.name: AddCustomStorageBasedLogConsistencyProvider
methods.description: Configures the silo builder to use a custom storage log consistency provider with a specified name and optional primary cluster.

methods.name: AddCustomStorageBasedLogConsistencyProvider
methods.description: Internal method to register necessary services for the custom storage log consistency provider, including protocol services, options, and logging support.
